fields.v: Synthesis: many apparent model failures originate in the surrounding system; improvements at one layer often do not propagate to end-to-end outcomes (e.g. retrieval metrics roughly doubled while end-to-end reward moved +0.035); advertised context is not usable context; standing context files showed no task benefit and ~20% added cost in Gloaguen et al. (2026), with Khatri (2026) bounding any correctness effect to about 10-15 points; Spearman -0.004 between urgency rank and having strong evidence across 52 ranked practices
